text: Alla no anndi ɓen sakkotooɓe woɗɓe goo e mon, fii no ɓen yiltora ɓaawo Nulaaɗo on ka hare, e ɓen wi'anooɓe musiɗɓe mun ɓen: Aree e amen, wata on tawtu mon ka hare, haa wareɗon, meɗen hulani on maayde. Ɓen ɗon non, ɓe arata e hare nden, ɓe tawtataa e mayre, si wanaa ko hawri, ɗum fow, ko no ɓe daɗndira ko'e maɓɓe wirtere, wanaa fii wallugol Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on.
